391c4816-d33d-4b07-9b1e-5cc97377fd10.title: The Hardening of the Heart
391c4816-d33d-4b07-9b1e-5cc97377fd10.text: When I first starting reading the Bible, this verse struck me as odd. Why would God harden the hearts of men? But as I grew more mature in my faith and continued to study God's word, I soon saw that it is not God who hardens our hearts, but ourselves. We manifest our existences into something we see as far greater than a relationship with God, and forget Him in all of our ways. This would be important to me to understand in people that no matter how many times we push, we may end up just making their perspective of faith worse, for their hearts are hardened. It is an act of letting go for the greater good, that God may still be able to use them despite their ways.

cbe834dd-d717-4e5e-8a86-68084a22305f.title: Thursday 5/14 Devotions Sharing
cbe834dd-d717-4e5e-8a86-68084a22305f.text:
Exodus 10-12
Psalm 105
Ephesians 2

Todays reading was really good! A lot of important passages and connections between them. The exodus and the passover, made me think of how vivid that memory would be for the people of Israel, the day they were freed from captivity to Egypt, and how God spared them because of the Passover Lamb. Connecting that with the gospel, and the cross, how God's might miracle of salvation is through Christ, and I was once dead in my sin. Yes I'm still struggling and fighting, but he has already won the victory, and saved. Psalm 105 capped it all off, by singing a song of praise for the works that God has done. I wanted to spend some time later today to genuinely thank and praise God for his salvation in my life, and remember all that he's done.

By the way guys, Ephesians 2:8-10 is something we should all memorize hehe

f720aea5-f7eb-430f-9ffa-6dbe458db734.title: May, 15, 2026 Notes
f720aea5-f7eb-430f-9ffa-6dbe458db734.text: Lord, this evening you remind me and guide me towards a truth that I have long known as head knowledge, but have yet to truly surrender to you; attention seeking – performance. Forgive me Lord for where I try to garner attention for myself and seat myself at the throne of my life, and the desire for others to put me on their thrones. Cleanse me of this sin and I thank you for this conviction that you’ve granted me to let go. To no longer derive my faith and my desire to serve you do to an underlying motive that is to serve myself. I thank you for this conviction. I thank you for your righteousness and the death and resurrection of your son, Jesus Christ, that has made it possible that I could call myself a child of God. Truly, I shall walk not by my own means, but by yours that I would practice my righteousness in secret. For you know all things and will be watching. So truly, why else does it matter that my neighbor sees my actions. I shall let this go to you Lord. Continue to convict and spur my faith and spirit in the direction of your cross, that I would be found serving in secret and for your stead.

7b575dc8-fb70-4e54-89f5-577624435d8d.title: The Israelites as a Representation
7b575dc8-fb70-4e54-89f5-577624435d8d.text: After reading through the events that the Israelites ventured through I began seeing a pattern between their lives and the lives that many Christians seeking the faith try to live. It demonstrates a life of struggle and pain, but truth in that God never strays from the mission of His people. His unconditional presence is a powerful source of peace and freedom to us all.

44eb5260-5d02-4984-9e5d-213df2b38e62.title: Sunday Service Highlights
44eb5260-5d02-4984-9e5d-213df2b38e62.text:
Jeff describes the contrast between our decisions in speaking to a man boastful about his accomplishments and speaking to a man discouraged in his struggle to achieve. 

I was thinking about how it is that I respond to people who choose to behave in a way that is not in sight of God's vision for us. If it were not someone that I am close with, I typically tend to stay away from making any comments on them, but if this were someone I am close to, I am much more willing, in fact, adamant about sharing my genuine thoughts about their actions and recent ways of thinking. 

The world has time and time shown us it's response to success, chase more, and failure, try harder. Both paths are a hamster wheel that forever reap little reward. 

God shows us that our response to success requires gratitude and prayer, and our response to failure requires gratitude and prayer. In these responses, we are sober minded, without greedy temptation. We are left with peace of mind, and love to which Paul identifies as the highest of all ways of life.
